details:
This appears to affect all platforms and all SDK versions. Whether a world description is changed on Creator Companion or on the website, the same issue occurs. Seems to be a backend issue.

I am trying to add a description to a newly uploaded world. The word "Black Jack" or "Blackjack" being in the description causes the text to become garbled. The text is removing all punctuation, symbols, and numbers and also scrambling words in a random way.

This does not occur if the only word in the description is "blackjack" with no other text. I also noticed that removing numbers, symbols, and punctuation affects this by making text less garbled, but the word "black jack" will still be changed to say "stack jack".

It seems that whatever is validating world descriptions is significantly malfunctioning with certain inputs. Attached is a screen recorded video showing some of this behavior, using a description submission on the website. The same issue occurs if the text is submitted in the Unity SDK.

For the time being, I'm using "BIack Jack" (the L replaced with a capital i) in the world description, and that validates correctly.

［Under construction］ Chill space station with lots of activities․ There are also some VR 3D 180 degree photos on display of behind the scenes NASA stuff and of a NASA museum. title: World Description Garbled Upon Submission With Certain Words And No Clear Pattern
